questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1993–94 Seattle SuperSonics win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: The 1966–67 Sixers’ 50-game start is still tied for the best ever. How many of those 50 did they lose?
questions.note: Just four: 46–4. The 2015–16 Warriors later matched it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers started the season at 46–4, which remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history

funFacts.text: The 1966–67 start would eventually be matched by Golden State's celebrated 2015–16 regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history (though tied in the Warriors 2015-16 season)

questions.prompt: In Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point game, how many points did everyone else on the floor score combined?
questions.context: Philadelphia Warriors vs New York Knicks · March 2, 1962
questions.note: 216: the two teams scored a record 316 in all.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The teams broke the record for most combined points in a game (316).

funFacts.text: The record shootout was played in Hershey, Pennsylvania, in a drafty old arena built for ice hockey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was played at Hershey Sports Arena, an old, drafty gym originally built for ice hockey.

funFacts.text: No video of the game exists; it was never televised.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was not televised, and no video footage of the game has been recovered

funFacts.text: In the fourth quarter, the Knicks fouled other Warriors on purpose to keep the ball away from Wilt.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: During the fourth quarter, the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry scored 43 in Game 4 of the 2022 Finals. How many did Ja Morant score against Curry's Warriors in 2022 Game 2?
questions.context: Ja Morant · Grizzlies vs Warriors · May 2022
questions.note: 47 points, including Memphis's final 15, to even the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ja Morant scored 47 points to match his postseason high

funFacts.text: Ja scored his team's last 15 points of the night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Morant scored the last 15 points for Memphis

funFacts.text: Memphis won Game 2 by five points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 106–101 victory over the Warriors
